MG995.basis: Published MG995 listing: 55 g, 9.4 kgf cm and 0.20 s/60deg at 4.8 V. Reuse lower-voltage data as a 5 V prior, not a measurement. PDF packaging/footer says 66 g; main specification says 55 g.

SG90.basis: Manufacturer analog SG90 specification: 9 g, 1.8 kgf cm, 0.12 s/60deg at 4.8 V. Product table also says 0.1s; use the slower specification. Actual variant is not confirmed.

PLA.basis: Engineering density assumption for PLA. Filament brand, actual printed mass and infill distribution are not measured.

controller.torque_speed_curve: linear motoring envelope; full stall torque available for braking
controller.provenance: 50 Hz command timing is a design choice. Delay, gains, friction, armature and deadband are unmeasured priors. Backlash and thermal behavior are not modeled.

contacts.provenance: Unmeasured contact priors. MuJoCo friction combines pair parameters; replace using surface tests.
